name: Tests on: push: branches: [ main ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] jobs: test: name: Run Django Tests runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Set up Python uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.12' - name: Install dependencies run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install django djangorestframework djangorestframework-simplejwt pip install django-cors-headers drf-spectacular django-filter pip install markdown bleach pillow django-redis - name: Run tests run: python manage.py test apps.articles -v 2
